title: Customer Priority Exchange: model admission routing and SLA-driven onboarding
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Introduce a 'Customer Priority Exchange' routing lane for model catalog admissions that lets enterprise customers exchange contractual credits or reserved capacity commitments for accelerated onboarding and stronger SLAs. This ticket defines policy, API flags, console UX, audit trail requirements, and mandatory eval/canary guardrails for priority submissions (new models, major version pins, and deprecation exemptions). The feature should preserve platform safety and compatibility checks while providing a transparent economic path for customers that need faster turnarounds.
acceptance_criteria: Policy: Define eligibility rules for Priority Exchange (contract status, minimum committed spend, compliance checks)
Routing: Implement routing policy that marks PR submissions as 'priority' and routes them to a fast-path queue with SLA targets and a shadow evaluation lane
API: Add model intake flag 'priority=true' to catalog submission endpoint and validate server-side with permission checks
Console: Add a Priority toggle in the model submission flow with inline tooltip explaining costs and guardrails
Audit: All priority actions produce auditable entries (who requested, contract id, SLA terms) surfaced in the Private control plane and the Console admin audit log
Evals: Mandatory lightweight compatibility evals and a 24-hour shadow canary before full rollouts for any priority admission
Metrics: Track time-to-admit, failures, and customer satisfaction for priority vs standard lanes
Docs: Public product docs and an internal runbook for Solutions/Support explaining escalation and refund/credit flows
